 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic, Agile engineering team, contributing to software development. You will collaborate with remote teams in a multicultural environment and help your colleagues excel. You will work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment, tackling challenging problems with current technologies and tools. Your role includes brainstorming and implementing new solutions and modeling engineering best practices.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Engineering.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full stack applications, APIs, web components, and services using modern frameworks and technologies
* Build production\-grade frontend and backend features using clean, maintainable, accessible, and testable code with strong focus on quality, reliability, and performance
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud\-native services, microservices, and APIs operating in production environments
* Participate in the design and implementation of reusable UI components, backend services, and platform capabilities
* Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver impactful solutions
* Work within an Agile/Scrum development environment utilizing automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and peer code reviews
* Troubleshoot, debug, monitor, and resolve production issues using testing frameworks, observability tools, and application monitoring systems
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing technical knowledge, learning new technologies, and promoting software engineering best practices


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
* 2\+ years of professional software development experience building scalable applications using object\-oriented programming languages and modern development frameworks
* Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and modern frontend development practices to build modular and reusable UI components
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and backend services
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS
* Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, or CosmosDB
* Experience with frontend and backend testing methodologies including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Git/version control systems, and Agile software development practices


**Preferred**

* Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud\-native application development
* Experience with frontend testing libraries and frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, or Selenium
* Familiarity with backend technologies and APIs using C\#, Java, Node.js, or similar technologies
* Understanding of Agile and test\-driven development methodologies
* Familiarity with data modeling and schema technologies such as JSON Schema or XML Schema
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills
* Passion for building high\-quality software and continuously learning new technologies and engineering practices


 Life at Docusign

 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Front End Engineer / Front End Developer - Remote - India
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back\-office easy for micro SMEs.
   

  

 We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing \- growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.
   

  

 We operate 3 business segments:
   

  

* Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with :5% market share of all new business incorporations
* Accounting \& Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
* FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses


 Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.
   

  

 We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of \>70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.
   

  

 Backed by world\-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech\-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.
   

  

**Requirements**
 We are looking for a Front End Engineer / Front End Developer that is excited about the below Mission and Outcomes.
   

  

**Mission:**
 The Front End Engineer / Front End Developer will lead the development of Sleek's customer\-facing digital experiences and growth\-driven microsites.
   

  

 This role blends frontend engineering, performance optimization, and marketing automation \- ensuring that Sleek's web properties are fast, discoverable, analytics\-integrated, and optimized for conversion.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Product Design, Growth, and Marketing teams to build SEO\-ready, CMS\-integrated, and data\-informed user interfaces that scale globally.
   

  

**Outcomes:**
* Launch High\-Performance Frontend Experiences
* Deliver Sleek's MTD landing page and web app frontend, ensuring performance scores above 90 on Lighthouse (Core Web Vitals compliant)
* Develop responsive, accessible, and pixel\-perfect UIs in React / Next.js / TailwindCSS aligned with Sleek's design system
* Reduce initial page load time and optimize for SEO to improve discovery and user conversion
* Build an SEO and Analytics\-Ready Microsite Framework
* Develop a microsite framework for future product verticals with reusable layouts and modular content components
* Implement schema markup, meta optimization, and structured data to strengthen search visibility
* Enable the Growth team to launch microsites independently without dev dependencies
* Integrate CMS for Content Autonomy
* Connect a headless CMS (Sanity / Contentful / Strapi) to Sleek's marketing sites
* Empower non\-technical teams to update content, landing pages, and campaigns autonomously
* Establish versioning, preview workflows, and rollbacks for content changes
* Implement Analytics, Tracking \& A/B Testing Infrastructure
* Deploy and configure Google Tag Manager, GA4, and Mixpanel for complete event tracking
* Implement A/B testing (Optimizely / VWO) to experiment with messaging, layout, and funnel optimizations
* Deliver actionable analytics dashboards and ensure event accuracy across web properties
* Automation Stack \- Webhooks
* Bonus Competencies \- Marketing Automation, CRO
* Build a Second Marketing Site for a New Product Vertical
* Create and launch a secondary marketing site targeting Sleek's next business vertical (aligned with the new marketing initiative)
* Ensure brand consistency, SEO optimization, and analytics instrumentation
* Achieve measurable conversion metrics tied to campaign performance


**Must have requirements:**
* Have a minimum of 4\-6 years of total engineering experience, with 1\-2 years specifically embedded within Marketing or Growth Engineering functions
* Strong frontend engineering mastery with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Proven ability to navigate complex environments, with experience in Micro Front Ends (MFE) considered a significant advantage
* Strong capability in SCSS for high\-fidelity UI; bonus points for expertise in TailwindCSS or Chakra UI.
* Committed to code quality through rigorous unit testing using Jest
* Deep experience in SEO and performance optimization, with a proven track record of maintaining Lighthouse scores of 90\+
* Strong integration capability with modern CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi) and advanced analytics stacks, including Google Tag Manager and GA4
* Proven cross\-functional delivery of data\-driven, SEO\-friendly web applications, including the setup and execution of A/B testing frameworks
* High ownership mindset with the ability to execute under ambiguity in a fast\-paced, startup\-like environment. You are hands\-on, detail\-oriented, and biased toward action
* Experience with Zapier or other no\-code automation tools to bridge the gap between engineering and marketing ops would be a bonus
* You will be located in India (working 9 am \- 6 pm Singapore time)


**Benefits**
 Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:
   

  

**Ownership** 
 : This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
   

  

**Humility** 
 : There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open\-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
   

  

**Structured Thinking** 
 : Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
   

  

**Data driven** 
 : We are a data rich business with :15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise \- so it's critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.
   

  

**The interview process**
 The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.
   

  

 Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.
   

  

**Screening Call with Talent Acquisition**
 A :30 minute screening call with our Talent Acquisition Lead
   

  

**Case study**
 A :60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager, where they will give you some real\-life challenges that this role faces, and will ask for your approach to solving them.
   

  

**Technical Round**
 A :60 minute chat with a member of the Technical Team. You may have to showcase your technical/coding skills.
   

  

**Soft Skills Round**
 A :45 minute chat with a member of the leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.
   

  

**Offer \+ reference interviews**
 We'll make a non\-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.
   

  

 \+\+\+\+\+
   

  

 Requirement for background screening
   

  

 Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.
   

  

 This may include using external vendors to verify the below:
   

  

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history


 We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.
   

  

 By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

description:
**Job Title: Junior Full Stack Developer**

* Contribute to releases, deployments, monitoring, and day\-to\-day application support activities
* Prepare technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team
* Support the improvement and modernization of existing solutions while helping maintain stable operations


 Mobile Solutions
   

  

* Contribute to the development and support of mobile applications connected to enterprise backends
* Help ensure secure and reliable communication between mobile clients and APIs
* Support mobile testing, release activities, and operational stability


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* A good foundation in C\#, .NET / .NET Core, or another modern object\-oriented programming language
* Basic understanding of web development, APIs, and REST\-based integrations
* Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases
* Understanding of software development fundamentals, debugging, testing, and version control
* Exposure to Angular or React is an advantage
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD concepts, or Azure is a plus
* Relevant internship, academic project, or early professional experience in software development is valued
* Exposure to enterprise applications, system integrations, or mobile solutions through projects or internships
* Basic understanding of authentication, secure coding, or cloud services
* Interest in domains such as equipment connectivity, fleet management, service operations, warranty, or aftermarket processes
* Experience contributing to team\-based software projects in academic or professional settings
* Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a software development role
* Comfortable working in a collaborative team environment with support from senior colleagues
* Structured and quality\-focused, with attention to detail
* Able to communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders
* Interested in working in Agile delivery environments


 You will learn from experienced developers, work on meaningful enterprise solutions, and build a strong foundation across development, support, integrations, and modernization. This role offers hands\-on experience in a collaborative international environment where your contribution will matter from day one.
   

  

 We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and encourage candidates who meet many, even if not all, of the requirements to apply. If you are motivated to learn, grow, and help build business\-critical digital solutions, we would be glad to hear from you.
   

  

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Front End Engineer (Design and Development)
description:
**Company: GreenChoice, PBC, the food intelligence company**
**Employment Type: Full\-Time**
**Location: India (preferred) or Remote**
**Experience: 3 to 5 years**
**We have multiple roles open—Please apply to only one role where you see a strong match with your skills and experience.**
**About GreenChoice**
 GreenChoice, PBC is the leading public benefit food health intelligence company. GreenChoice gives 40\+ food retail and technology partners instant access to personalized nutritional guidance, evidence\-based food health scores, and verified health attribute data on over 1 million food products, with award\-winning integrations to meet consumers' changing health needs and provide medically tailored food\-as\-medicine benefits. GreenChoice has already guided over 10 million healthier purchases. Google named GreenChoice one of the three "Best Apps for Good" in the U.S.
   

  

 GreenChoice is backed by Katapult and BonBillo Ventures, partners with Stanford University School of Medicine, and members of the Tufts Friedman School Food \& Nutrition Innovation Council. GreenChoice is guided by a Science Advisory Board of leading PhDs, dietitians, and researchers in public health, nutrition science, environmental science, and behavior change.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Front End Engineer at GreenChoice, you will both design and build the web and mobile experiences our users interact with every day. This is a dual role. You will create the designs yourself, in Figma, and then bring them to life in React.js and React Native with Expo. You own the experience end to end, from the first wireframe to the shipped, responsive interface.
   

  

 We are not looking for someone who only implements other people's mockups. You will be the person deciding how a feature should look and behave: mapping the user flow, designing the screens, prototyping the interactions, and then writing the code that makes it real. That means strong design judgment matters as much as strong engineering skills here.
   

  

 You will work closely with product and backend engineers to ship features that feel fast, look right, and are genuinely easy to use. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable in a design file and a code editor, cares deeply about the details of the user experience, and wants full ownership of front end features from concept through production.
   

  

**Design**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the UI/UX for front end features: take a problem or product idea and design the flow, screens, and interactions for it.
* Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma, and iterate on them based on feedback.
* Make the call on layout, visual hierarchy, typography, color, spacing, and interaction patterns so the result is clear and easy to use.
* Define and maintain a consistent visual and interaction language across web and mobile.
* Design the full picture, including the states that are easy to forget: loading, empty, error, edge cases, and responsive breakpoints.


**Frontend Development**
* Build and maintain web applications with React.js and mobile applications with React Native and Expo.
* Implement your own designs as high\-quality, pixel\-accurate interfaces.
* Implement responsive design and ensure cross\-browser and cross\-platform compatibility.
* Manage application state cleanly using Redux, Context API, or similar tools.
* Build reusable, well\-structured components and front end patterns.


**Integration And Collaboration**
* Work with backend engineers to integrate REST and GraphQL APIs and ensure smooth data flow into the UI.
* Participate in code reviews and front end technical discussions.


**Quality And Maintenance**
* Write unit and component tests to keep the interface stable.
* Keep code clean, well\-documented, and reusable.
* Debug, optimize, and monitor front end performance, including load times and rendering.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* 3 to 5 years of experience, with a track record of both designing and building front end interfaces.
* Strong design ability: you can create your own designs in Figma (wireframes, mockups, prototypes), not just implement someone else's.
* A real grasp of UI/UX fundamentals: usability, visual hierarchy, typography, color, spacing, and interaction patterns.
* A portfolio or examples of work that show both the design and the built result.
* Strong proficiency in:
+ React.js
+ React Native with Expo
+ JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3

* Experience with state management tools (Redux, Context API).
* Solid understanding of responsive design, cross\-browser compatibility, and accessibility.
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative tools (Asana, Slack, code versioning workflows).
* Comfortable consuming and integrating REST and GraphQL APIs.
* Able to work independently in a startup environment and own features end to end, from design to deployment.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with TypeScript.
* Familiarity with front end testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, React Testing Library).
* Experience optimizing performance for mobile and low\-bandwidth conditions.
* Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library.
* Familiarity with user research, usability testing, or analytics to inform design choices.
* A formal background or training in design (visual, interaction, or product design).
* An interest in sustainability, food systems, or health tech.


**What We Offer**
* Salary: $15000\-$20000 USD per year (based on location \& experience).
* Equity options in a growing early\-stage startup.
* Flexible working hours and remote work opportunities.
* Mission\-driven team with a collaborative and inclusive culture.
* A chance to have a real\-world impact on how people eat and live healthier, more sustainable lives.

title: DWS Client Integration Architect
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

**What success looks like in this role**

The **Digital Workplace Solutions Client Integration Architect** is responsible for ensuring seamless integration of Device Subscription Services (DSS) and Device\-as\-a\-Service (DaaS) into client environments, enabling a fully functional, end\-user device lifecycle experience.


This role bridges the gap between client IT ecosystems and Unisys DSS capabilities, ensuring that all required systems, processes, data flows, and governance models are successfully integrated. The architect ensures that DSS and DaaS operates as cohesive services across procurement, provisioning, asset management, financial management, support, and disposal.


Success in this role means:


* DSS is fully embedded into the client’s IT and business ecosystem with minimal friction
* All integration points (tools, data, workflows, suppliers) operate reliably and at scale
* Client\-specific requirements are translated into standardized, repeatable DSS integration patterns
* Implementation timelines are reduced through reuse of integration frameworks and accelerators
* Risks related to data, process, or tool misalignment are proactively mitigated
* Tools are accessed to ensure they are implemented using best in\-class solutions based on capabilities

**Key Responsibilities**

The DWS Client Integration Architect works closely with Solution Managers, Solution Architects, Delivery teams, and Client stakeholders to design and implement integration models for DSS adoption.


**Integration Design \& Architecture**

* Define end\-to\-end **integration architecture** for DSS within client environments
* Map client systems (ITSM, HR, Finance, Procurement, Asset Management, Device Management) to DSS and DaaS processes
* Design **data flows, APIs, and system interfaces** required for DSS operations
* Establish integration patterns for:
	+ Order\-to\-provision workflows
	+ Asset and configuration data synchronization
	+ Incident, service request, and support processes
	+ Billing, chargeback, and financial tracking

**Client Environment Alignment**

* Assess client IT landscape, tooling, and process maturity
* Identify gaps between current state and DSS operating model
* Define required changes to client processes, policies, and governance
* Ensure DSS aligns with client compliance, security, and regulatory requirements

**Implementation \& Delivery Support**

* Support solutioning and deal phases with integration designs and effort estimates
* Work with delivery teams to ensure integration requirements are implemented correctly
* Define **integration runbooks, workflows, and operational procedures**
* Validate integration readiness prior to go\-live

**Standardization \& Reusability**

* Develop **standard integration blueprints and reference architecture** for DSS
* Create reusable assets such as:
	+ Integration patterns (API, batch, event\-driven)
	+ Data models and mapping templates
	+ Interface specifications and documentation
* Drive consistency across regions and clients

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Act as the primary integration interface between:
	+ Client IT and enterprise architecture teams
	+ Unisys solutioning and delivery teams
	+ OEMs, suppliers, and ecosystem partners
* Facilitate workshops to define integration requirements and solution approaches
* Translate complex integration topics into clear, business\-aligned language

**Governance \& Risk Management**

* Identify and mitigate integration risks early in the lifecycle
* Ensure proper data governance, ownership, and quality controls
* Define SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics for integration performance
* Support ongoing service improvements based on operational insights

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve DSS integration efficiency through:
	+ Automation
	+ API standardization
	+ Platform consolidation
* Incorporate lessons learned into future solution designs
* Support evolution of DSS integration capabilities aligned to market needs
* Drive cost\-effective DSS integration design and delivery
* Improve DSS effectiveness, deployment times, and maintenance by enabling AI capabilities

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

**Skills and Qualifications**

**Experience \& Knowledge**

* 5–10 years of experience in **IT architecture, system integration, or enterprise solutions**
* Strong experience with **ITSM, asset management, and enterprise platforms** (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Helix, SAP, etc.)
* Proven experience designing and implementing **system integrations and data flows**
* Experience in **device lifecycle or managed workplace services** preferred
* Understanding of **ITIL processes** (especially Service Design, Service Transition, and Service Integration)
* Experience in creating **high\-level design (HLD)** and **low\-level design (LLD)** documents and workflows

**Technical \& Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of:
	+ APIs, middleware, and integration technologies
	+ Data models, data mapping, and synchronization
	+ Workflow orchestration across multiple systems
* Ability to design **scalable and repeatable integration architectures**
* Familiar with automation, digital experience, and analytics platforms

**Consulting \& Communication**

* Strong client\-facing and workshop facilitation skills
* Ability to translate complex technical designs into clear business outcomes
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders
* Strong documentation and presentation skills

**Personal Attributes**

* Structured, detail\-oriented, and pragmatic
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to navigate ambiguity
* Collaborative and able to influence without direct authority
* Self\-driven and comfortable working in global, distributed teams
* Focused on standardization, scalability, and reusability

**Additional Expectations**

* Contribute to DSS playbooks, integration guides, and sales enablement materials
* Support pre\-sales and business development activities where integration is a critical component
* Stay current with emerging integration technologies, platforms, and industry trends
* Act as a thought leader in DSS integration strategy and best practices

description:
Job Description: Office Coordinator \-The LexSphere

**Organisation:** The LexSphere **Location:** Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh (On\-site) **Role Type:** Full\-Time **Reporting To:** Founding Advocate / Principal

About The LexSphere

The LexSphere is a pan\-India legal consultancy and educational platform offering corporate advisory, labour law compliance, HR architecture, contract drafting, legal notices, and legal education content. Operating across consultancy, content, and academic verticals, The LexSphere serves individual clients, corporate entities, HR professionals, and law aspirants. With a rapidly growing digital presence and an active in\-house team, we are looking for a sharp, organised, and proactive Office Coordinator to anchor our day\-to\-day operations.

Role Overview

The Office Coordinator will serve as the operational backbone of The LexSphere. This is not a passive administrative role \- the person in this position will be expected to manage communication pipelines, coordinate across multiple internal teams, maintain documentation discipline, and ensure that every client touchpoint, internal deadline, and institutional process runs without friction. You will work directly alongside the founding team and interface with our creative, content, and legal functions daily.

Key Responsibilities

**Client Coordination and Intake**

* Manage initial client communication across WhatsApp, email, and phone channels with a professional and responsive approach.
* Coordinate client onboarding, document collection, and appointment scheduling.
* Maintain a clean record of ongoing matters, follow\-up timelines, and client correspondence.
* Support the WhatsApp Broadcast and CRM pipeline by organising leads, tracking conversions, and flagging pending responses.

**Internal Team Coordination**

* Act as the coordination link between the legal team, content team, design function, and intern cohort.
* Liaise with the intern coordinator to track task assignments, submission deadlines, and intern performance records.
* Schedule and document team meetings, briefings, and review calls.
* Maintain a shared task tracker and ensure team deliverables are logged and followed up.

**Administrative and Documentation Management**

* Handle drafting, formatting, and dispatching of formal correspondence including legal notices, office communications, and client\-facing letters under supervision.
* Maintain physical and digital filing systems for client documents, contracts, compliance records, and institutional paperwork.
* Track office expenses, vendor invoices, and coordinate with accounts for timely payments.
* Support the preparation of presentations, proposals, and service catalogues as directed.

**Operations and Platform Support**

* Coordinate with the content team on scheduling, deadlines, and platform requirements for YouTube, Instagram, and WhatsApp content rollouts.
* Assist in managing institutional collaborations, event coordination, and external outreach logistics.
* Monitor and manage the general inbox and ensure no query goes unresponded within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain office supplies, vendor relationships, and general infrastructure functioning.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline (preference for Law, Commerce, or Management).
* Minimum one year of office coordination, administration, or legal office experience.
* Strong command over written and spoken Hindi and English \- Hinglish communication comfort is a plus.
* Working proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace.
* Comfort with WhatsApp Business, basic email management, and digital file organisation.
* High attention to detail, particularly in documentation and correspondence.

Preferred Qualifications

* Background in or exposure to a law firm, legal consultancy, or compliance\-driven work environment.
* Familiarity with content or creator business operations.
* Experience handling multi\-channel client communication simultaneously.
* Basic understanding of labour law, POSH, or HR compliance terminology is an advantage \- not a requirement.

What We Offer

* A fast\-paced, high\-learning work environment at the intersection of law, content, and institutional building.
* Direct exposure to live corporate advisory, compliance, and legal education operations.
* Structured team culture with defined roles, clear accountability, and regular review.
* Growth opportunity into a senior operations or client management role as the platform scales.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

Who Should Apply

This role suits someone who takes ownership naturally, communicates clearly without being asked twice, and thrives in an environment where no two days look the same. If you are the person who notices what needs to be done before being told \- this is your role.

**To Apply:** Send your CV along with a brief note (not more than 150 words) on why this role interests you to \+91 9170270812 or info@thelexsphere.com. Applications without the cover note will not be considered.

*The LexSphere is an equal opportunity workplace. We evaluate candidates on merit, reliability, and attitude.*

title: Technical Salesforce Specialist
description:
**Why join Thynk?**
-------------------


Founded by a team of experienced SaaS founders and hospitality executives, Thynk is on a mission to revolutionize the 2T$ hospitality industry and become a new vertical SaaS giant. Our ambition is fuelled by a fantastic product built on top of the Salesforce platform and a spot on time to market.


We raised a 13M$ Series A from high\-profile VCs (NY\+EU) to scale our operations and expand to the US. Your role is key at our stage to make sure we scale the right way, it is an opportunity to have a big impact on the company.


Our customers are all over the world and so are we, with team members from 25 nationalities, based on 3 continents and 6 time zones \- building a strong common culture while respecting the individual constraints of everyone in our remote\-first environment.


Thynk is also going through a deep AI transformation — we are rebuilding how our internal teams work, from sales to delivery, around AI tooling (Claude, Cowork, Code). Joining us today means being on the inside of that shift.

  

By joining the Thynk Team, you will recognize yourself in our values:

* **Ambition** \- We think big and act boldly. We’re organized to move fast, scale quickly and set industry standards.
* **Care** \- We believe in the power of being surrounded by a diverse international team of all\-stars, who are caring about each other and our customers. We prioritize balance and wellbeing.
* **Innovation** \- We look at the big picture to develop new solutions never done before. We believe in asking questions, challenging, and rarely taking no for an answer. We encourage our customers to do the same, and partner with them to bring forth this change.
* **Service** \- We develop services for people whose businesses are, above all, about quality of service. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and our technology is simply a means of helping them deliver exceptional service to their customers.

**About the role**
------------------


We are on a mission **to revolutionize the $2T hospitality industry** and to **become a new vertical SaaS giant**. As a rapidly growing SaaS company with high\-performance teams and a collaborative culture, this position is vital to Thynk’s success.

**Our Professional Services team is scaling alongside our US expansion**. We are hiring a Salesforce Specialist **based in India, working a US\-coverage shift**, to deliver hands\-on configuration and data work for our American customers — and to give our EU\-based PS team clean, same\-day hand\-offs.


You will join the Professional Services organization led by Nicolas Arfouilloux (VP Delivery \& CS), reporting directly to Maud, our SF Specialist Team Lead. You will **work alongside a fully remote team of Implementation Leads, Solution Engineers, and Customer Success Manager**, supporting customers from boutique hotel groups to global hospitality chains.

**Our product is a vertical SaaS suite built natively on the Salesforce Platform.** As a Salesforce Specialist you will work **hands\-on with the Thynk managed package across customer orgs — configuring modules, manipulating data, and supporting customers** and the internal team through every phase of implementation and post\-go\-live.

 **Your ramp\-up project: AI\-driven document migration**


Your first major mission will be a structural migration project for our customer base: moving from PDFButler custom template documents to the Thynk\-native e\-proposal and document generator. You will use Claude (Cowork and Code), our internal AI tooling, and lightweight scripting to parse legacy templates, map them to the new system, and re\-generate them at scale. This is high\-leverage, AI\-augmented work — and it sets the tone for how the rest of your role will look at Thynk.

**Beyond the ramp\-up, AI is now embedded in our way of working** — from configuration scaffolding to data inspection, from documentation to customer artifacts. You will be expected to use AI tooling daily, build small assistants and scripts as needed, and contribute to making our Professional Services team measurably faster.

**‍ As our Salesforce Specialist at Thynk, you will:**
------------------------------------------------------


Contribute as an individual contributor **in a strong, fully remote team and be a team player in a highly collaborative environment.** You will be responsible for:

* **Configuring the Thynk product on customer Salesforce orgs:** page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, custom fields and objects, record types, list views, Flow Builder automations, reports and dashboards — using Salesforce declarative tools.
* **Performing data manipulation and migration tasks:** data loading, cleansing, deduplication, and ETL of customer data via Data Loader, Workbench and similar tools; building SOQL queries to inspect, validate and report on records.
* **Driving AI\-augmented migrations and document workflows** — starting with the PDFButler Thynk e\-proposal \& document generator transition across customer accounts, using Claude (Cowork, Code) and scripting to parse, map, and regenerate templates at scale.
* **Building lightweight internal tooling and AI assistants to accelerate recurring PS work:** prompts, agents, small scripts, evaluation harnesses. Treat AI as a co\-worker, not a feature.
* **Supporting and running technical workshops, UAT cycles, and configuration reviews** with customers in English — bridging the gap between business requirements and Salesforce implementation.
* **Troubleshooting customer issues during implementation and post\-go\-live**, working closely with Implementation Leads, Customer Success Managers and the Engineering team.
* **Documenting configuration decisions, customer\-specific setups, and reusable AI prompts / scripts** in our internal knowledge base (Notion \+ Salesforce documentation).
* **Operating in a US\-shift schedule from India to give our American customers same\-day support** and to hand off cleanly to the EU\-based team each morning.
* **Continuously improving how we deliver:** spotting recurring patterns, productizing them with AI, and contributing to our PS playbook.

**About you**
-------------

**You will be a great fit if:**

* **You have 3 to 5 years of hands\-on Salesforce experience** (admin/configurator/consultant), with production work you can describe in detail.
* **You are Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM\-201\)** — or actively pursuing it. Platform App Builder is a plus.
* **You are fluent in Salesforce declarative tools**: Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets, page layouts, record types, custom objects, reports \& dashboards.
* **You can read Apex, understand triggers and SOQL queries, and debug from logs and error messages.**
* **You are comfortable with bulk data operations** (Data Loader, Workbench, SOQL) and you take data quality seriously.
* **You are AI\-curious and AI\-active:** you already use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot or similar in your daily work — or you are visibly eager to do so. You are comfortable writing prompts, iterating, evaluating outputs, and scripting around LLMs (Python, JS, or shell) to get useful work done.
* **You communicate clearly in English** (written and spoken) and can hold a technical conversation with a non\-technical customer.
* **You are based in India and willing to work shifted hours to cover US time zones** (typically \~4pm to 0am IST), 5 days a week, on a permanent basis.
* **You operate well in a remote, async, multi\-cultural environment.**

**Bonus points if you have:**

* **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs:** writing agents, designing prompts at scale, evaluating outputs, or scripting AI workflows in production.
* Experience **implementing or supporting a Salesforce\-based ISV / managed package.**
* Experience with **document generation tools** (PDFButler, Conga, Docusign Gen, Nintex Drawloop, etc.) or **e\-signature platforms.**
* Exposure to the **hospitality, travel, or events industry.**
* **Familiarity with integrations:** Salesforce APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Workato, Zapier), or REST API consumption.
* **Advanced Salesforce certifications** (Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud).
* **Basic Apex or LWC development experience.**

***This job is made for you if you like:*** *getting hands deep into customer configurations, solving puzzles with data, treating AI as a power tool rather than a buzzword, and seeing the direct impact of your work on a customer going live. You enjoy a fast\-moving, no\-bureaucracy environment, and you like being the technical person customers trust when something needs to be figured out.*

***This job is not for you if you’re not:*** *comfortable owning your time and deliverables without micro\-management, ready to work shifted hours consistently, eager to learn a vertical (hospitality) that goes beyond just Salesforce, or sceptical that AI will be part of your daily toolkit.*

**What you can expect :**
-------------------------


We will provide **the best IT equipment** of your choice (Apple or Windows)


**We are remote\-first**: As a fully remote team of repeat entrepreneurs, we value communication, teamwork, and transparency above all.


**Global\-first**: You will join an international team with 21 nationalities on 3 continents : we organize monthly meetings and yearly events to gather all the team together. English is our first language .


**We are people\-first**: We care about our people (team members, clients, and partners), we value work\-life balance, and consider any request to achieve fullfillment at work.

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

* **Introduction call with Louise** (Global HR Lead \- 20 min)
* **1h technical fit interview with Maud** (SF Specialist Team Lead)
* **Take\-home practical test (\~1 hour)** — Salesforce configuration \+ small data manipulation exercise, with an explicit AI\-assistance component (you are encouraged to use Claude / your tool of choice and tell us how you used it).
* **30 min debrief on the practical test with Maud \+ one senior Tech team member**
* **Final interview with Nicolas Arfouilloux** (VP Delivery \& CS)

Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


**Your mission**

**Position Summary** : The Area Retail Associate (ARA) supports the Area Sales Manager by ensuring operational excellence, brand consistency, and sales performance across multiple PUMA SIS in a designated region. This role acts as a bridge between store teams and area leadership, helping drive store execution, training, and compliance.


**Reports to:** Manager Sales MBO (Upper North)


**Key Objective:**

**1\.Store Support \& Operations:**  

* Assist multiple SIS with day\-to\-day operational requirements.
**2\.Sales Performance \& Targets:**  

* Track SIS\-level KPIs
* Support SIS Staff in achieving sales targets through improved service and selling skills.
* Analyze SIS performance and share insights with the Area Sales Manager.
**3\.Visual Merchandising:**  

* Ensure VM standards are implemented consistently across all SIS.
* Coordinate with VM team for execution of seasonal updates, campaigns, and product launches.
* Audit SIS display quality and provide corrective action plans.
**4\.Inventory \& Stock Management:**  

* Assist SIS in stock replenishment, stock counts, and shrinkage control.
* Identify fast/slow\-moving products \& support stock balancing across stores.
* Report stock gaps and discrepancies to the Area Manager.
**5\.Training \& Team Development:**  

* Conduct on\-floor training for new and existing Retail Associates.
* Reinforce product knowledge, customer service expectations, and selling skills.
* Support performance coaching for SIS staff.
**Key Performance Indicators**

* Net Sales
* Brand Ranking at SIS doors
* Brand Desirability, Store Hygiene, Store Operations
* Training scores, Product Knowledge
* Up scaling Existing Space allocation
* New locations in premium Doors

**Organizational Relationships:**

* **Internal** : Puma Corporate team ,Merchandising/ Trading, Projects, Training and HR
* **External** : SIS Distributor \& Team and Store/SIS Owner, Dept/Floor Manager

**Your talent**

**Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:**

* 2–5 years in retail operations.
* Experience handling multi\-store/SIS/LFR or supervisory retail roles is an advantage.
* Field\-based role—requires daily/weekly travel across assigned stores.
* Flexible hours, including weekends and retail peak seasons.

**Education**

* Graduate (Preferred: Business, Retail, Marketing).

**Our principles**

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Date:** 1 Jun 2026


**Location:** IN


**Company:** Coats


**Job Title: Assistant Manager \- Training**  

**Location: Ambasamudram**

  


**Role Purpose:**



The purpose of this role is to establish and sustain a highly proficient training culture focused on job safety, job\-specific part analysis, and quality system requirements for all newly recruited employees in Dyeing and Finishing operations. This training program is designed to equip employees with the necessary skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively, ensuring safe working practices, adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), and consistent production quality. Through structured training, employees will be prepared to contribute to achieving production targets on time while maintaining high\-quality standards. The objective is to ensure that all new employees become fully competent and job\-ready within a period of six weeks.

  


**Principal Accountabilities:**


* Recruit new male, female, contract employees based on job requirements for Synthetic, Lab, Cotton, Finishing.
* Design training manuals as per organizational needs.
* Conduct one\-day orientation training for new male, female and contract employees.
* Conduct written tests on Safety and SOP knowledge.
* Retrain and re\-test employees who do not meet the required marks.
* Monitor and review employee performance along with managers.
* Maintain discipline and ensure orderliness in the workplace.
* Maintain good industrial relations between department and HR, Build teamwork within and across shifts.
* Promote effective communication within all sections.
* Develop and ensure safe work practices as per safety regulations in dyeing and finishing floor.
* Monitor and control employee absenteeism and attrition.
* Motivate employees to give suggestions on Safety, Quality and Productivity through RISE.
* Evaluate employee performance using PAT (Part Assessment Test) forms.
* Conduct final performance review with Department Manager/IE Manager after training completion.
* Update and revise training manuals based on changes in work and market conditions.
* Provide multi\-skill training to approved employees within and across the department.
* Identify poor performers and arrange refresher training as per department head advice.
* Monitor behaviour\-based safety practices on the shop floor.
* Organize and manage the Training \& Development Centre.
* Coordinate plant visits for new visitors, Handle HoloLens training activities.
* Prepare PPTs and videos related to Health \& Safety and sustainability.
* Participate in Shift Safety Briefings (SSB) to promote safety and quality practices.
* Support to TaRA (Task Risk Assessment) assessment to ensure zero accidents in the dye house.
* Improve operator morale through regular performance reviews.
* Conduct daily shift meetings and communicate effectively with operators.
* Identify and develop employees with high potential.
* Eliminate workplace hazards \& maintain a safe 6S environment standard in the workplace by training.
* Organize and coordinate department safety committee meetings.
* Track safety records such as: Safety suggestions, Unsafe acts, Caution slips, PPE issuance and replacements.

  


**Education, Qualifications and Experience****:**


* Bachelor’s degree or related field.
* Minimum 5 to 7 years’ experience in dyeing and finishing, full process knowledge.
* Colour Physics (Level 2\).
* Sedomaster application basics.
* Overall, Dyehouse and Finishing operating procedure.
* Integrated Quality management systems.
* Different types of Coats sewing threads.
* Dyeing machine operation \& global dyeing programs.
* Finishing final winding, packing.
* All D\&F SOPs and Training system.
* D\&F Health and Safety SOP and PPE requirements for different chemicals and equipment.
* 6S Housekeeping principles.

  


**Desirable****:**


* Team development capability
* Time management skills
* Excellent communication skills, proficient in English
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office tools

  



At Coats Group, we are committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a diverse and collaborative environment where every team member can thrive. If you are passionate about making an impact in the textile industry and eager to join a global leader with a rich heritage and a forward\-thinking approach, we invite you to take the next step in your career with us.

title: Analyst Payroll
description:
**About us:**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about TII**  

  

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**About the team**

This team is responsible to handle the nonexempt \& exempt pay for US Target Team with 100% accuracy, meeting the timeliness and ensuring compliance with federal and state laws. Training and developing subject matter expertise of existing and new TM’s, and maintaining process documentation in partnership with HQ team. Communication with internal and external partners on key process updates and maintain positive relationship building credibility for the business.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Daily payroll activities:**

* Processing payroll checks with 100% accuracy and pay on time.
* Working pay run audit reports and ensuring error/issues are fixed before paychecks are printed
* Analyzing pay run reports and taking proactive steps to identify any issues causing a trend and reporting to partners.
* Work \& Monitor all payroll mailboxes \& ensure 24 hours SLA is met for all the request/forms
* Ensure awareness of all policies and compliance relating to US payroll and apply during the execution of daily work.  

Partnering with onshore team in driving volumes during peak and critical times.
  

Support the team on Adhoc projects for yearend pay’s and manage year end calendar change.  

Ensure internal audit controls are placed for meeting 100% accuracy of the team, draw quality trends to identify the opportunity areas and rectify.  

Daily communication with Team on work allocation, work load management to ensure the business timelines are met, along with communicating with partners Via workload status to ensure the critical tasks are handled on time avoiding any impact on pay check.  

Well equipped with subject knowledge to process all the critical activities during BCP situation to support the US and India payroll team to ensure TM pay on time.  

Equipping existing TM’s and training contractors during peak season on high volume driving process and ensure their quality is audited.  

Taking ownership in reducing the overpayments by Reconciliation of unmatched voucher account and partnering with GL team to have the records of TM accurate.  

Identifying areas to streamline the process, initiating projects to save time and increase accuracy.  

Building subject knowledge amongst TM’s and encouraging them to contribute ideas, and help them contribute to process improvements.

 **REPORTING/WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports to Manager, Payroll Operation.
* Works closely with the Payroll Training and Documentation Team, Payroll Leadership, Internal Communications, Pay \& Benefits, HR Operations Center (HROC), HR Field Process Team, and Store and DC Operations.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor degree in Accounting/Business /Human Resources
* FPC/CPP/Payroll Certification is must.
* End to End knowledge on US payroll and taxation
* Requires 5\+ years of payroll experience with excellent knowledge on all Federal and State Laws
* Proficient on Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Attention to detail, accurate and professional communicator
* Demonstrated integrity with respect to confidentiality of employer and employee interests
* Commitment to the principles of coaching
* Display problem solving ability based on the situation
* Displays ability to analyze information to drive business decisions.


Flexibility to work extended hours.

title: Engineering Manager 2
description:
**Job Title:** Engineering Manager 2
**Posting Start Date:** 6/1/26
**Job Location(s):** Bengaluru
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.



Requisition ID: 77662


**Job Description:****Description**



The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB’s IC Verification Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on chip\-level verification. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed \& complex front\-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US.

  



As the Verification manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving chip top level verification. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad.

  



In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company.

  



We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast\-paced dynamic team environment.

**Responsibilities**



The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US leading IC design.

  



Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:



* Recruiting \& Staffing:


* + Jointly drive staffing \& recruiting with HR to ensure a world\-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs.
* Technical Leadership:

	+ Act as the IC Verification \& Technical Leader for a team focused on the verification of RFICs that are integrated into our complex front\-end modules

	+ Experience managing large technical teams

	+ A track record of growing successful design teams

	+ Ability to set \& articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those

	+ Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug\-tracking and reporting
* Communication:

	+ Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1:1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US.
* Travel to US will be required from time to time


**Required Experience and Skills**


* The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status \& schedule progress to senior management.


* Technical requirements:

	+ Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools

	+ Deep and broad expertise in functional AMS verification of RFICs including RF/Analog/Digital content

	+ Develop and maintain verification plans, strategies and methodology

	+ Perform functional, behavioral and regression verification

	+ Collaborate with RF designers and chip leads for successful tapeout and release of products to guarantee first\-pass success

	+ Automate verification flows and reporting infrastructure

	+ Strong debug and root\-cause analysis skills
* Circuit Analysis:

	+ Understanding of analog blocks including low bit count data converters (ADC \& DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op\-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge\-pumps, Temp sensor, LDO, ESD, e\-fuse and other supporting cells.

	+ Knowledge of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning \& RF LNA design.

	+ Digital Design including SPI \& MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines.

	+ Semiconductor device and process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe.
**Minimum Requirements**


* BSEE; MS preferred


* 10\+ years of IC Design/Verification experience


* 6\+ years of Technical Leadership and Management experience



Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Date live: 06/01/2026


Business Area: Group Technology Service Management


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000109678


  
Join us as an HR Application Service Manager at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.


To be successful as an HR Application Service Manager , you should have experience with:


* IT Service Management (ITSM): Strong experience in Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request management (ServiceNow preferred), with a focus on SLA adherence and service stability.
* HR Technology Platforms: Hands\-on experience managing HR systems such as Workday, ServiceNow , or similar enterprise HR applications.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage third\-party vendors and engage with business stakeholders to ensure service delivery, issue resolution, and performance governance.
* Production Support \& Operations: Experience in managing L1/L2/L3 support models, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent fixes.

Some other highly valued skills may include:


* Automation \& Continuous Improvement: Exposure to automation tools and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Monitoring \& Observability: Experience with application monitoring tools and proactive alerting frameworks.
* Governance \& Compliance: Understanding of audit, risk, data privacy, and resilience frameworks
* Agile \& Transformation Exposure: Experience working in Agile environments and supporting HR transformation or digital initiatives.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


The role is based out of Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage the IT Services department and set the strategic direction, provide support to the bank's senior management team, and to manage IT Service risk across the organisation management of IT Services to support the banks operations and representing Technology service performance with senior stakeholders and managing IT service risk across the organisation.


**Accountabilities**


* Development of strategic direction for IT Services, including the implementation of up\-to\- date methodologies and processes.
* Management of the IT Services department, including oversight of IT Services colleagues and their performance, implementation of departmental goals and objectives, oversight of department efficiency and effectiveness. .
* Relationship management of IT Services stakeholders, including identifying relevant stakeholders, and maintenance of the quality of external third party services.
* Development and implementation of policies and procedures for IT Services, implementation and adherence of control targets and standards, policies and procedures for IT Services, managing adherence to group SLAs and controls associated with core technology production activities in incident, problem, and change.
* Management of IT Services risk, including identification of potential IT Services risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the bank’s change and compliance functions. .
* Monitoring the financial performance of the IT Services department, including revenue, profitability, and cost control, driving value from any commercial agreements, strong management of any directly controlled costs etc.
* Management of IT Services projects, including driving successful research and related product launches, and deliverance of integrated solutions to clients.
* Effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

Job Description


Role: **Data Management Manager**

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description:**


The Commercial Data Management Manager will be responsible for managing the execution of the Data Platforms Operations in partnership with the Technology team, driving continuous innovation, operational excellence, and cost efficiencies. The manager will oversee execution of features aligned with one or more of our Data Platform product teams and work with the global team and functional partners to implement additional capabilities to the platform aligned with business objectives. Also, the manager will partner with the Senior Manager, Data Platforms to initially focus on the transition efforts from the vendor teams, building a highly talented and data\-focused team in our Innovation Center in India. You will also be responsible for partnering with our Amgen Technology partners and peer teams in the US and India to plan, design and implement large and strategic Data enabling programs.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Execution of Data\-Enabling Features in Product Teams**

* Lead and oversee prioritization, execution and deployment of features in one of our Commercial Data Platforms Product teams aligned with standard operating procedures
* Lead various stages of SDLC as a member of the Data Management Operations teams – including requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders across the US Commercial Organization (including Incentive Compensation, Field Reporting, Forecasting, Secondary Analytics), design, testing and documentation in partnership with the Technology teams in a Product Team setting.
* Partner with peer teams in the US and technology teams to review requests, design solutions, estimate effort and prioritize requests in assigned Product backlog
* Communicate with stakeholders through various stages of the SDLC and ensure alignment with stakeholders, and management on effort, solution, timelines and expectations
* Accountable for ensuring governance processes are followed and appropriate system testing, User Accepting Testing (UAT) are done and documentation is set up to ensure traceability through the lifecycle of deployment
* Responsible for working with syndicated data sets including IQVIA data – DDD, Xponent, ELAAD, etc., Digital Marketing data sets including Patient and Physician level data sets and internal data sets like HR data, Call Activity data from CRM systems, Patient Hub data to set up and enable HCP \& Patient centric connected data sets for our stakeholders
* Build connected data products for Amgen’s Commercial Data and Analytics function leveraging data sets mentioned above that enable insights around Prescriber \& Patient behaviour \& engagement patterns to support more efficient targeting algorithms
* Manage the Big Data platform infrastructure (Built on AWS tech / Airflow for Data storage and orchestration and Databricks for processing) – including access to the platform, platform costs, ad hoc capabilities for users, data quality, etc.
* Partner with the US teams and Technology teams to evaluate and implement tools and technologies to support the future state of the platform including Automated Anomaly detection, Automated document generation, Bots against data, Searchability of data assets, LLM models on data and documents and other Gen AI capabilities
* Partner with the Technology teams and direct line management to implement processes to monitor system health, set up alerts for anomalies and implement steps to proactively remediate areas of concern on the infrastructure front
* Partner with peers across our four pillars – Master Data Management, Data Platforms, Patient Data Management, Data Acquisition \& Governance to ensure alignment on solutions implemented for stakeholders
* Identify and highlight roadblocks, process gaps, and resourcing needs to the Leadership team as part of continuous improvement efforts.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and highlight to direct line management and strategize roadmap for deployment

 **Manage Work Transition and Insourcing**

* In partnership with the Senior Manager Data Platforms, develop and oversee transition plans to migrate work to our Amgen India Innovation Center with minimal disruption and develop standard processes for onboarding peers and broader team.
* Execute on the insourcing of our Operational Data Management Services currently delivered by external vendors, ensuring appropriate knowledge transfer, risk mitigation, and operational readiness.
* Build robust repository of knowledge transition documents and set up processes for efficient operations within a global team framework

 **Facilitate Cross\-Team and Organizational Engagement and Alignment**

* Partner closely with peers in Commercial Data Strategy core pillars and Data Management Senior Manager to contribute to delivering against our priority initiatives and establish new ways of working, especially across time zones.
* Work with our Technology/IT partners and the US team members in Product Team setting and partner with other Product teams to ensure deliverables are aligned with the Platform governance model
* Act as a liaison between at our Amgen India Innovation Center with other Customer Data \& Analytics Teams to ensure alignment on goals, processes, and success measures.

 **Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* any degree and 8 to 13 years of relevant data management experience
* Proven experience in working in global teams and across time zones and cultures
* Proven experience in working in Product teams and delivering high quality solution in adherence with established processes
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Excellent English oral and written communication.

 **Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Prior experience and success working in high\-performing data management teams, with clear demonstrations of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience leading and supporting Data Platforms Operations \- including executing in Agile Product teams, overseeing phased execution of Platform enhancements and innovations
* Prior experience in executing in major data transformation projects with global teams, including core teams located in India.
* Prior experience in data architecture and data flow design, data modelling and in data profiling
* Prior hands\-on experience and expertise in technologies such as AWS and Databricks with ability to dig into problem statements and partner with teams in Root cause analysis and in planning and implementing long term remediation
* Hands\-on experience with data analysis using tools and technologies like SQL, Python, R, etc.
* Prior experience in partnering with stakeholders and technology teams in solution design for small features as well as complex large programs
* Quick learning agility to understand new concepts such as our end\-to\-end Commercial data flows to identify and remediate interdependencies.
* Collaborate with peers, India leadership team and peer teams in the USA to stay ahead of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in data acquisition and build multi\-year forward looking Data platform roadmaps.
* Alignment with best practices and a commitment to championing new and innovative methodologies and tools to enhance data strategies and solutions to drive business outcomes.

 **Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Experience working in the life sciences commercial data domain space, ideally in the areas of Data Platforms and Patient Data.
* Understanding of the syndicated commercial data sets and use cases
* Worked in multinational settings with teams from different countries.
* Basic understanding of compliance and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with and application of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

 **Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional collaboration and communication skills.
* Strong data \& analytics/critical\-thinking and decision\-making abilities.
* Able to perform well in a fast\-paced, changing environment.


Strong oral, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts and controversial findings clearly and compellingly.

**Position Overview and Objective**

As a Manager for Governance, risk \& Compliance, information technology \& security GRC professional, with a great track record for managing the execution of GRC programs.
